reply_text:
Hi Bettina, I can't set up this recurring digest. I don't have a scheduling tool in this workspace, so I can't create a job that posts every Monday at 08:00. Nothing has been scheduled or posted.

I can still do it by hand. Ask me in #coastal-team and I'll pull the previous week's activity from #coastal-team and #coastal-random and the open customer items, then post the "Coastal week ahead" digest. Two things to know first:

- **#coastal-random:** I'll only read it if you're a member, so I'll check that before I include anything from it.
- **Finance figures:** if open customer items include contract values, per-seat rates, prices, discounts, invoice amounts or payment terms, I'll leave those out of the channel post. They can only go to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark and the account owner, unless Anselm or June approves otherwise. Seat counts, renewal dates, products and ticket numbers are fine to include.

If you need a true weekly schedule, someone with access to the platform's scheduling settings will need to set it up.
